incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL) and Articles R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the centralized Guichet Unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts de la SARL (Articles of Association) and Form M0 (registration declaration filed with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for SARL. Any stated cash capital must be paid up at subscription to at least 20%, with the balance paid within five years. Contributions must be held in a temporary blocked account (compte bloqué) and released only upon RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a general meeting of all associates, the following resolutions are unanimously adopted: (1) The share capital of EUR 10,000 is subscribed in cash and fully deposited in the blocked bank account, apportioned as per the articles of association. (2) The registered office of the company is adopted at 82 Rue de Rivoli, 75004 Paris, and the Gérant is authorised to relocate the office within Paris on simple notice. (3) Monsieur Jean Dupont is appointed sole Gérant with full management powers, including power to issue invoices and bind the company, excluding acts reserved by law. (4) The statutory filing team is directed to complete M0 and legal-publication formalities. This resolution is effective as of this date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability and legal form due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI databases and Infogreffe company name search
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the INPI national database for identical or confusingly similar corporate names and trademarks. Confirm that the corporate object of middle-market cross-border M&A advisory is compatible with SARL permitted objects under Article L.223-1. Reserve distinctive denomination if desired.
required_dossiers: Passports or identity cards of founding associates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a conflicting name or mark is found, select a new distinctive name and repeat the clearance search; any opposed trademark can be monitored or jointly waived.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of articles of association and appointment of manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders acting by recorded decision; may be assisted by a notary or legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft final statutes in French, include legal form, duration, registered office address, corporate object, share capital, share subscription table, and management powers. Sign all pages, annex manager acceptance letter if separate, and ensure no notarial form is required unless real-property contributions are made.
required_dossiers: Proof of right to occupy registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registry objects to clauses, execute a rectifying decision or amend the statute and re-sign; supplemental article amendments must be filed with the same formality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed French bank or authorised payment institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company being formed. Deposit cash capital contributions and obtain a bank certificate identifying the company, each contributing associate, the amounts, and the account details. The bank will release funds only upon presentation of the Kbis or a sworn notary certificate.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening resolution or instruction letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses release conditions, request a corrected certificate or use a notary's escrow mechanism to evidence capital availability.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of legal notice in an authorised legal journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Insert a mandatory legal announcement containing the exact corporate name, legal form, registered office, corporate object, amount of share capital, associates, and manager. Request the publisher's certificate of publication, which will be attached to the registration dossier.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal journal returns the notice for incompleteness, correct the announcement at once and republish; ensure publication occurs within the six-month period before filing the M0.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of incorporation dossier with Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Form M0 online and attach the certified articles, legal-publication certificate, bank block certificate, manager acceptance, proof of office address, and beneficial-owner declarations. Validate the dossier and track the transmission acknowledgment. The registry performs legal regularity control before registration in the RCS.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the dossier, correct the flagged items via the Guichet Unique within the given deadline; errors in the statutes may require a rectifying shareholders' resolution to be filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Kbis and release of capital to operational bank account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and the blocked-account bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the registry validates incorporation, obtain the official registration certificate (extrait Kbis). Verify the registered address, object, manager, capital, and shareholding. Submit the Kbis to the bank to release blocked funds and convert the temporary account into the company's operating account.
required_dossiers: Identification details of the newly registered SARL
Bank instruction letter for fund release
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry delays issuance of Kbis, obtain an attestation of pending registration from the Greffe; if the Kbis contains substantive errors, file a request for rectification with a concise explanatory note.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: CCI Paris Île-de-France and the Préfecture de Police de Paris for the Loi Hoguet professional card governing transactions on business assets and fonds de commerce

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office and intellectual advisory activity not listed in the project categories of Article R122-2 of the French Environmental Code; no industrial installation or classified activity threshold is crossed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial VOC-emitting operations. For office occupancy, if water is discharged to public sewerage, municipal effluent limits under the Code général des collectivités territoriales apply; waste must be handled by registered collectors under Articles L.541-1 et seq. of the Environmental Code.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate must be obtained from the local Commission de Sécurité for premises open to the public or for ERT buildings; structural load and accessibility inspections are required before occupancy; workplace legal-entity declaration, electrical installation conformity, and occupational-health monitoring under the Code du travail must be in place.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — online portal: impots.gouv.fr (corporate tax) and formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (one-stop shop for incorporation and registration); VAT non-established registration via formulaire service on impots.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign shareholder forming a French SARL must register the entity with the RCS through the guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), obtaining SIREN/SIRET; the INSEE SIREN serves as the corporate tax number for impôt sur les sociétés. VAT: a VAT number (numéro d'identification TVA, format FR<key><SIREN>) is delivered by DGFiP via Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) upon filing the standard business registration dossier or, for foreign entities without a PE, the specific non-resident VAT registration application (cerfa no. 14073 / P0) plus proof of establishment abroad and a local tax representative only when required; the business must also file an annual declaration of tax result assigned to the competent SIE. M&A advisory is a regulated activity requiring prior AMF/DORSH? no — M&A intermediary license under AMF is not generally required for pure advisory, but the point is tax. Keep it concise.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France; foreign-exchange and capital-movement reporting and enforcement also involve the French Ministry for the Economy and Finance, the Directorate-General of Customs and Indirect Taxes (Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects), and the French Financial Markets Authority (Autorité des marchés financiers) where regulated investment services are implicated.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro and operates within the euro area, with no general exchange controls, capital-account restrictions, or administrative approval requirement for ordinary cross-border payments in euros or foreign currencies. Current-account receipts, service fees, dividends, interest, loan repayments, and capital proceeds may generally be received, converted, and remitted through regulated payment institutions or banks, subject to anti-money-laundering, sanctions, tax, accounting, and payment-services controls. Capital contributions, intercompany loans, acquisitions, and distributions remain subject to corporate-law approvals, beneficial-owner identification, transfer-pricing requirements, withholding-tax analysis, thin-capitalization and interest-limitation rules, and documentary verification by the servicing bank. Cross-border payments involving sanctioned jurisdictions, restricted persons, dual-use goods, or unusual structures may be blocked or escalated. A French M&A advisory business may require authorization or registration if its actual services constitute investment services, investment advice, placement, reception and transmission of orders, corporate-finance services regulated under the French Monetary and Financial Code, or services performed on financial instruments; purely strategic or business consultancy must be distinguished from regulated investment activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No general French requirement requires a company to surrender export proceeds to the Banque de France, convert export receipts within a statutory period, or maintain a prescribed foreign-currency conversion ratio. France has no general mandatory export-proceeds repatriation or conversion rule for ordinary commercial services. Service and export invoices must be properly recorded, and customs, VAT, Intrastat, statistical, tax, and bank reporting obligations may apply depending on the transaction and counterparty. Banks may request contracts, invoices, proof of performance, and source-of-funds evidence before crediting or transferring proceeds. Cash, negotiable instruments, or equivalent monetary instruments of EUR 10,000 or more carried across applicable EU external borders are subject to customs declaration rules; separate reporting may apply to certain cross-border payments and accounts under French tax and regulatory rules.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for operational payments and foreign-exchange execution, but low to medium as the sole banking architecture. An EU-authorized electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide payment accounts, safeguarding, SEPA transfers, international transfers, and, where authorized, foreign-exchange services. It may not necessarily provide a French statutory capital-deposit service, deposit-taking, credit, overdraft, or the full documentary-credit functionality of a bank. The institution's passported permissions, safeguarding model, settlement partners, country-risk policy, and treatment of a French SARL must be verified. Offshore digital EMIs outside the EU cannot lawfully provide regulated payment services into France without an applicable authorization or passporting basis. Fintech accounts may be unsuitable for high-value M&A success fees, escrowed client money, regulated investment activity, or transactions requiring bank-issued letters of credit. Client money must not be commingled with corporate operating funds, and any receipt or transmission of client funds may trigger payment-services or investment-services authorization requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal requirement that all directors physically attend a bank branch to open a corporate account. Remote onboarding may be permitted using qualified or reliable electronic identification, video identification, certified corporate documents, and beneficial-owner verification. The bank may nevertheless require a physical meeting, wet-ink signature, French-resident representative, branch appointment, or in-person verification based on risk, non-resident ownership, complex ownership, politically exposed person status, high-value expected flows, regulated financial activity, adverse media, or inability to validate identity electronically. Capital deposits for formation may require a bank-specific process and a certificate of deposit before registration. The SARL should obtain written confirmation that the selected bank will onboard the entity before relying on a particular incorporation timetable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder, director, or ultimate beneficial owner; ownership chain includes several jurisdictions or nominee arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified constitutional documents; current commercial-register extracts; complete ownership chart to each natural-person beneficial owner; passports and proof of residential address; tax-residence information; UBO declaration; shareholder register; director appointment documents; explanation of control rights; and certified translations where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: M&A advisory activity classified as regulated investment advice, placement, reception and transmission of orders, or other investment service
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed service-perimeter memorandum; client engagement templates; confirmation of whether financial instruments or client orders are involved; AMF or ACPR authorization, registration, or legal opinion where applicable; compliance manual; conflict-of-interest policy; professional-indemnity insurance; AML program; and evidence that client funds and securities are not held without authorization.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value success-fee wires, irregular transaction volumes, or payments involving acquisition targets and financial sponsors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed engagement letters; success-fee calculation schedules; transaction closing documents; invoices; proof of advisory services; expected-volume and expected-country profile; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth information for relevant payers; sanctions screening results; and transaction-flow diagram.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of third-party payers, payment from an acquisition vehicle, or receipt of funds unrelated to the invoiced client
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board or client authorization; agency or assignment agreement; explanation of payer-beneficiary relationship; beneficial-owner information for payer and client; invoice reconciliation; bank evidence of the underlying transaction; sanctions and adverse-media screening; and written bank pre-clearance for exceptional payment routing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment flows involving high-risk, sanctioned, heavily cash-based, or secrecy-oriented jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country-risk assessment; sanctions-screening evidence; beneficial-ownership documents; commercial rationale; underlying contract and invoice; legal review of applicable EU and French sanctions; enhanced due-diligence report; and documented senior-management approval where the bank permits the transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected client-money handling, escrow, settlement, or pass-through activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Funds-flow policy; legal analysis of payment-services and investment-services perimeter; separate-account structure; safeguarding or client-money arrangements; reconciliation controls; authorized signatory matrix; client terms; independent audit or compliance review; and evidence that no unauthorized deposit-taking or custody occurs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared business activity, ISIC classification, website content, invoices, and expected account usage
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan; website and marketing review; service catalogue; sample engagement letter; revenue model; client segmentation; operating budget; projected monthly transaction matrix; tax-registration evidence; and management explanation of any ancillary activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete tax transparency information, including CRS or FATCA classification uncertainty
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French tax identification number; CRS self-certification; FATCA status and forms where relevant; tax-residence certificates; accounting records; entity classification analysis; and confirmation of reportable controlling persons.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route paid-in capital through a French bank or other institution legally able to issue the required capital-deposit certificate. Use a transfer from an account held in the subscriber's name, identify the payment as share capital or capital contribution, and provide the draft articles, subscription schedule, shareholder resolution, UBO information, source-of-funds evidence, and incorporation documents. After registration, release the funds to the SARL operational account upon delivery of the registration extract and bank-required evidence. For subsequent equity injections, document the share issue, contribution to equity, or shareholder loan; obtain corporate approvals; record the correct accounting and tax treatment; and use a payment reference consistent with the legal instrument. SEPA Credit Transfer is generally appropriate for euro payments; SWIFT MT103 or equivalent cross-border messaging may be used for non-SEPA or foreign-currency payments. Banks may request purpose, payer, beneficiary, intermediary-bank, and source-of-funds information. Do not use unidentified third-party funding, personal accounts, cash, or informal value-transfer systems.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For ordinary advisory fees and operating expenses, use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within the SEPA area and SWIFT MT103 or an equivalent bank payment message for non-SEPA or foreign-currency transfers. Reconcile every payment to an approved invoice, contract, tax treatment, beneficiary verification, and sanctions screening. For cross-border M&A fees, retain engagement letters, closing certificates, fee calculations, and evidence of service completion. A Commercial Letter of Credit is generally unnecessary for intangible advisory services but may be used in a genuine bankable transaction if the bank accepts the documentary conditions; issuance, advising, confirmation, amendment, and settlement should follow the applicable ICC rules, commonly UCP 600 for documentary credits. Bank guarantees, standby letters of credit, and documentary collections require separate credit approval and may create contingent-liability, sanctions, and accounting obligations. Avoid describing an advisory payment as a trade-goods payment or using unrelated commercial invoices. Where the SARL receives or transmits client funds, confirm licensing and segregation requirements before execution.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward exchange contracts with an authorized bank or eligible investment firm, used to hedge documented foreign-currency receivables, payables, acquisition fees, or committed funding; maintain an underlying-exposure file and comply with suitability, appropriateness, confirmation, collateral, and reporting requirements.

Non-deliverable forwards where the currency, counterparty, and transaction are legally and operationally supported; settle the net difference in an agreed currency, document the commercial exposure, and assess EMIR clearing, margin, reporting, and risk-mitigation obligations.

Currency swaps and cross-currency swaps with an authorized counterparty for documented funding or liquidity exposures; approve counterparty limits, collateral terms, valuation methodology, termination provisions, and accounting treatment.

Currency options, collars, and option-based hedges where appropriate for genuine commercial exposures; obtain product-risk approval, assess MiFID classification and appropriateness, and prohibit speculative trading outside the treasury policy.

Spot foreign-exchange transactions through regulated banks or authorized payment institutions for ordinary conversion needs; retain trade confirmations, rate evidence, payment purpose, and reconciliation records.

EU EMIR and MiFID-related obligations may apply depending on the instrument, counterparty, entity classification, transaction volume, and use of clearing or trading venues. The SARL should maintain a written treasury policy, board-approved limits, segregation of duties, hedge documentation, counterparty due diligence, independent valuation, and records sufficient for tax, accounting, audit, and regulatory review.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and management report filed with the Registry (dépôt des comptes annuels et du rapport de gestion)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce – Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the shareholders' annual general assembly that approves the accounts; the assembly must be held no later than six months after the fiscal year end (calendar-year SARL: assembly by 30 June; filing by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate €1,500 late-filing fine per requirement; administrative strike-off procedure after 4 months of non-filing; loss of access to public procurement and inability to pay dividends

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return on profits (déclaration de résultats standardisée / liasse fiscale) including supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year fiscal year: by the second business day after 1 May of the following year; for non-calendar year: no later than the third month following fiscal year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of tax due, increased by 0.8% per month until filing; systematic 10% automatic increase if filed after notice; possible tax reassessment for an additional three-year lookback

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of corporate data in the RCS (confirmation d'inscription / demande d'actualisation annuelle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce – RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the annual financial statements filing; generally no later than 31 July for a calendar-year SARL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm leads to removal from the commercial register; fines up to €15,000; the board may be disqualified and the company struck off after loss of legal status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner confirmation (déclaration de confirmation des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce – RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be submitted together with the annual financial statements filing; any change in ultimate ownership or control must be separately declared within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: €5,000 fine per natural person and €25,000 per legal entity; imprisonment of 6 months for intentional non-disclosure; additional registry strike-off exposure for repeated non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory audit is compulsory if the SARL exceeds two of three thresholds at fiscal year-end: balance-sheet total > €4,000,000; net turnover (excl. VAT) > €8,000,000; average headcount > 50 employees. Mandatory appointment of a certified public accountant also occurs for obligated entities (credit institutions, investment firms, clearing houses and certain holding structures).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (German? No – French GAAP, incorporating ANC regulations; IFRS authorised only for consolidated financial statements of listed companies, not for the statutory unconsolidated SARL annual accounts)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each annual accounts filing, the SARL must confirm to the RCS that the existing beneficial owner declaration remains accurate. Any necessitating event – direct share transfer, indirect control restructuring, change in voting rights or change in the chain of control – must be uploaded within 30 days. Failure to confirm annually blocks the issuance of a valid certificate of incorporation and can trigger punitive fines.
